title: ProdigySMP
description: Build solo or co-op with friends, protect your base with Land Claims, and grow your wealth through a full Economy & Auction House. Trade with players, open Crates, and grab daily Vote Rewards!
body:
ProdigySMP is a **survival** server where your journey starts the moment you place your first block and grows into whatever empire you choose to build. **Claim your own land**, expand your borders, and rise from a humble plot to a thriving nation. Team up with friends to found a nation together or carve out your own solo stronghold and build at your own pace.

Build your fortune through a player-driven **Economy** and crack open **Crates** for exclusive loot, Got grinding in you? We've got **15,000+ Quests** to keep you busy, plus daily **Vote Rewards** just for supporting the server.
